summary: Segmented 3D cell aggregates are available (Drosophila wing disc masks in S-BIAD3120; Arabidopsis embryo and meristem stacks; zebrafish neural-tube packing), but none is paired with a tension measurement on the same tissue, and the tissue set is a few animal epithelia and plant meristems rather than tissues in general. The mouse compaction study S-BIAD1057 has micropipette-linked contact measurements on doublets.
next_step: Pick one segmented set (S-BIAD3120 is the cleanest, CC licence to be confirmed) and decide the independent tension source (laser ablation or aspiration papers) before pre-registering.
obstacles_confirmed: Minimal area can emerge from several interacting processes.
Plant meristems and a few animal epithelia stand in for tissues in general.
